Steps: open Authentication, start second factor, submit. Expected: the verification code is accepted. Actual: an error appears and nothing is saved. Seen on build 4104.

title: Session timeout warning
text:
As a team member, I want session timeout warning so that the authentication work is easier to finish.

Also known as idle logout. The expiry banner setting lives under Authentication. Acceptance: given a member on the authentication screen, when they use session timeout warning, then the result is saved and shown. Related key PRJ-005.

title: Session timeout warning fails
text:

Steps: open Authentication, start idle logout, submit. Expected: the expiry banner is accepted. Actual: an error appears and nothing is saved. Seen on build 4106.
